summary.en: OK Computer anxiety under festival lights—art-rock that somehow holds a muddy field.
summary.zh: 音乐节灯光下的 OK Computer 焦虑——艺术摇滚居然撑住一片泥地。

whyEpic.en: 1997 Glastonbury is the night alternative proves it can command the UK's biggest farm without stadium-rock clichés. Paranoid Android stretches; the crowd stays. Nervous music becomes communal weather.
whyEpic.zh: 1997 格拉斯顿伯里证明：Alternative 能征服英国最大农田，而不靠体育馆陈词滥调。Paranoid Android 拉长；人群不走。紧张的音乐变成公共天气。

rightsNote.en: No full embeds. Prefer BBC/official licensed archives.
rightsNote.zh: 不嵌整场。优先 BBC/官方授权存档。
